title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Runtime Header Refinement — message 2

metadata.content:
On the macOS ChatGPT app, the GitHub connector is available only if your account has the repository connector feature enabled. If it is, here's how to access it:


Open New Chat.


Click the + (or paperclip) next to the message box.


Look for Connectors or Add source.


Choose GitHub.


Select your repository (for example, kore20lllc-netizen/korelumina).


Ask your question.


If GitHub is attached, I should be able to answer questions like:


"Find appearance.ts."


"Where is executiveMaterial defined?"


"Trace every use of ProductionNavigator."


without asking you to run terminal commands.
If you don't see GitHub
There are two common reasons:


The GitHub connector hasn't been enabled for your account yet.


The macOS app hasn't exposed the repository picker, even though your GitHub account is connected.


Let's determine which case you're in
When you click the + (or paperclip) beside the prompt, what options do you see? List them exactly, or send a screenshot of that menu. That will tell us whether the repository connector is available or if your GitHub connection is only for account integration rather than repository access.
